# Myco

> Myco is the nervous system for AI-assisted software teams. It captures what coding agents do, turns it into durable project knowledge, and hands that knowledge back to every agent and teammate on the project.

Myco 2.0 keeps a team's knowledge on a server the team runs on Cloudflare or on its own laptop or virtual machine; Myco's commands call it a Deployment. Each person's machine signs in with `myco login <invite link>`, which sets up their coding agents, and `myco member join` connects each repository to a project. Those agents then capture sessions to the server and read from it through MCP. Myco's own work runs on a worker on an administrator's machine. It titles sessions, learns and curates spores (decisions, gotchas, discoveries, trade-offs, fixes), learns from a project's code, and keeps a code map. The server's dashboard shows all of it, and everything is configured there.

macOS and Linux are supported. Myco 2.0 on Windows is coming in beta.1; the Windows installer installs Myco 1.4.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://myco.sh/): Product overview and install command.
- [Quickstart](https://myco.sh/quickstart.md): Set up a server, invite people, sign a machine in and connect its repositories.
- [Upgrading from 1.4](https://myco.sh/upgrade-from-v1.md): Move a Myco 1.4 machine to 2.0 with `myco cutover`, and what it keeps.
- [Self-hosting](https://myco.sh/self-hosting.md): Run a server on a laptop, a virtual machine or Cloudflare; updates and backups.

## Using Myco

- [The dashboard](https://myco.sh/dashboard.md): Today, Sessions, Knowledge, Myco's work, and the administrator's People & machines, Settings and Health.
- [How Myco learns](https://myco.sh/intelligence.md): What Myco produces from captured sessions, where that work runs, and what agents get back.
- [Agents](https://myco.sh/agents.md): The agents Myco captures, how to connect them, and what is captured.
- [Agent tools](https://myco.sh/agent-tools.md): The MCP tools agents use to search and curate a project's knowledge.
- [External agents](https://myco.sh/external-agents.md): Access keys for agents that are not members, such as hosted code reviewers.
- [Configuration](https://myco.sh/configuration.md): Server settings, what Myco does in each project, starting work by hand, and machine settings.
- [Troubleshooting](https://myco.sh/troubleshooting.md): The messages people meet most and what to do about each.

## Optional

- [Install script for macOS and Linux](https://myco.sh/install.sh): The Myco 2.0 shell installer.
- [Myco 2.0 architecture](https://github.com/goondocks-co/myco/blob/main/docs/architecture/myco-2.0.md): How the server, members, workers and capture fit together.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/goondocks-co/myco): Source code, issues and releases.
